rules.name: Copy fixes
rules.instruction: Explicit requests to correct a typo, wording, punctuation or existing translation. Preserve product promises and business meaning.

rules.name: Visual fixes
rules.instruction: Explicit implementation requests for local spacing, alignment, overflow or styling, with a specified target or an objectively established existing standard/correct state to restore. Locating an element or calling it inconsistent, unattractive or hard to understand does not establish a target. Do not invent visual style, information hierarchy, rendering or interaction decisions. No redesign, new interaction or behavior. A known spacing defect does not authorize adjacent undefined restyling; assess only a clearly separable authorized scope. If direction or scope is unsettled, observe only: no acknowledgement, worker or unsolicited question.

description.zh: 智能体的 GitHub 账号；每条链路从一个 Issue 仓库接收通知，在对应的执行仓库执行代码并接收 PR 讨论与 CI 状态。所有链路共用本卡的账号与 CLI。
description.en: The agent's GitHub account; each chain receives notifications from its intake repository and executes code, PR discussion, and CI in its code repository. All chains share this card's account and CLI.

label.zh: 仓库链路（一个 Issue 仓库 → 一个执行仓库）
label.en: Repository chains (one intake repository → one code repository)

hint.zh: 至少配置一条链路。每行一个链路：id 用 lowercase-kebab-case，id 与执行代码的仓库必填，接收 Issue 的仓库留空即使用同一个执行仓库。每个链路独立轮询、独立执行，所有链路共用本卡的 GitHub CLI 与账号。
hint.en: Configure at least one chain. One row per chain: id is lowercase-kebab-case, id and code repository are required, and an empty intake repository uses the same code repository. Each chain polls and executes independently; every chain shares this card's GitHub CLI and account.

hint.zh: 命令名或绝对路径，通常是用 GH_CONFIG_DIR 登录智能体账号的 gh 包装脚本。智能体以它登录的账号行事，执行器以 gh 调用它。保存时检查它登录的账号能否推送到仓库，然后重启 dsh-superagent。
hint.en: A command name or absolute path, usually a gh wrapper signed in to the agent account through GH_CONFIG_DIR. The agent acts as the account it is signed in to, and the Executor calls it as gh. Saving checks that this account can push to the repository, then restarts dsh-superagent.

hint.zh: GitHub 要求更长间隔时以 GitHub 为准。
hint.en: A longer interval requested by GitHub wins.

label.zh: 连续失败几次后报告异常
label.en: Failed polls before reporting an error

hint.zh: 单次网络中断会在下一次轮询时自动重试，不必报告。
hint.en: A single network interruption is retried on the next poll and need not be reported.

label.en: Receive new Issues in the repository

hint.zh: 打开后，没有 @ 智能体的新 Issue 也会收到，由策略的接收表决定是否成为候选。从打开的时候开始，不读以前的。
hint.en: New Issues that do not mention the agent are received too, and the Policy's admission table decides whether they become candidates. Starts when switched on; earlier ones are not read.

label.en: Receive new pull requests in the repository

hint.zh: 打开后，没有 @ 智能体的新 PR 也会收到，由策略的接收表决定是否成为候选。
hint.en: New pull requests that do not mention the agent are received too, and the Policy's admission table decides whether they become candidates.

hint.zh: 打开后，Issue 和 PR 上没有 @ 智能体的评论和代码评论也会收到，由策略的接收表决定是否成为候选。
hint.en: Comments and review comments on Issues and PRs that do not mention the agent are received too, and the Policy's admission table decides whether they become candidates.

hint.zh: 打开后，默认分支的 CI 失败和恢复会收到，由策略的接收表决定是否成为候选。
hint.en: Failures of the default branch's CI, and its recovery, are received, and the Policy's admission table decides whether they become candidates.

chains.en: default: cinvymoe/rust_crane_issues → cinvymoe/rust_crane; p-0d3a3830: cinvymoe/dsh-superagent-prototype → cinvymoe/dsh-superagent-prototype

label.zh: 能发起工作的 GitHub 账号
label.en: GitHub accounts that may originate work

label.zh: 评论可以成为候选的机器人
label.en: Bots whose comments may become candidates

hint.zh: 名单里的机器人账号（例如 dependabot[bot]）的评论在来源收到时成为推断的候选，交给评估：评论 @ 了智能体，或者打开了“接收仓库里的评论”。它们不能发起明确的请求，也不能停止工单；其他机器人的评论不接收。
hint.en: A comment of a bot account on this list, such as dependabot[bot], becomes an inferred candidate for an assessment when the Source receives it: when it mentions the agent, or with Receive comments in the repository on. Such a comment never makes an explicit request or stops a ticket; other bots' comments are not admitted.

explicit.zh: 名单里的账号在 Issue 或评论里 @ 智能体的账号。
explicit.en: An account on the list mentions the agent's account in an Issue or a comment.

description.zh: 在 Web 面板中提交需求并审阅对齐结果。
description.en: Submit requirements and review alignment in the web panel.

explicit.zh: 在本地面板提交需求或评论
explicit.en: Submit a requirement or comment in the local panel

note.zh: 面板中提交的需求与评论
note.en: Requirements and comments submitted in the panel

description.zh: 这个工单的执行目录；执行器 Session 在其中工作
description.en: This ticket's directory; the executor Session works in it

description.zh: 工单的短名，也是执行目录的名字
description.en: The ticket's short name, also its directory's name

description.zh: 这个执行环境禁止调用的命令，以空格分隔；不要运行它们
description.en: Commands blocked in this execution environment, separated by spaces; never run them

description.zh: 执行代码的仓库，owner/name。智能体在这里检出代码、推送分支、开 PR；分支最后一段是 DSH_SUPERAGENT_NAME 时（例如 agent/$DSH_SUPERAGENT_NAME）会关联到工单
description.en: The code repository, as owner/name. The agent checks out code, pushes branches, and opens PRs here; a PR from a branch whose last path segment is DSH_SUPERAGENT_NAME (for example agent/$DSH_SUPERAGENT_NAME) binds to the ticket

description.zh: 接收 Issue 的仓库，owner/name；工单来自这里，但代码在 DSH_SUPERAGENT_GITHUB_REPOSITORY 执行
description.en: The Issue intake repository, as owner/name. Tickets come from here, while code executes in DSH_SUPERAGENT_GITHUB_REPOSITORY

description.zh: 智能体的 GitHub 账号；gh 以它登录，除自动合并外的 GitHub 操作都用 gh，不用其他账号或凭据
description.en: The agent's GitHub account. gh is signed in to it; use gh for every GitHub operation except auto-merge, and never another account or credential

description.zh: 智能体账号的提交邮箱。这里的 git 没有身份：按提示词写明的作者提交，没有写明时用智能体账号和这个邮箱
description.en: Commit email of the agent's account. git has no identity here: commit as the author these instructions name, or as the agent's account with this email when they name none

description.zh: 接下工单的 Issue 或 PR 编号；工单不是从 GitHub 来的时为空
description.en: Number of the Issue or PR that started the ticket; empty when the ticket did not start on GitHub

description.zh: 接下工单的 PR 的 head 引用 refs/pull/<编号>/head；不是 PR 时为空
description.en: Head ref refs/pull/<number>/head of the PR that started the ticket; empty when it was not a PR
